_comment: One entry per wiki page (docs/wiki/<page>.md and its de/DE-<page>.md). The site renders the wiki; this adds only what a search engine needs and the wiki cannot hold: a clean URL, a search title and a meta description in both languages. Navigation order and labels come from docs/wiki/_Sidebar.md. tests/test_site_pages.py fails when a wiki page has no entry here.
